description: Bruitages et musiques du monde Sous-marin Narval (dossier /41/ des cartes SD).

sons.prompt: Deep submarine sonar ping echoing, followed by a low brass swell, underwater cinematic intro
Dark damaged submarine interior, metal hull creaking under pressure, faint hiss of stale air, heavy slow breathing far away, seamless loop
Submarine interior with emergency power restored, electrical hum, small ventilation fans, distant creaks, seamless loop
Submarine emergency klaxon alarm, two-tone, echoing in metal corridors
Loud deep groan and crack of a steel submarine hull under water pressure
Huge steel submarine hull scraping and sliding on rocks underwater, long grinding rumble, debris falling inside
Heavy watertight door wheel turning with a screech, then the steel door swinging open with a thud
Metal padlock clicking open, small steel locker door opening
Hand-cranked dynamo whirring up for one second, mechanical gear whine
Electrical switchboard powering up, relays clicking one after another, rising electric hum, fluorescent lights flickering on
Electrical short circuit, loud spark crackle and breaker snapping off, power dying down
Single stroke of a manual hydraulic hand pump, metallic creak and oil gurgle
Hydraulic system pressurizing, rising hiss and pipe knocking, ending with a firm clunk
Underwater telephone static burst, crackle and hiss
Heavy steel latch bolt being ratcheted and released with a loud metallic clank
Tense low submarine thriller underscore, pulsing low strings and sonar-like synth, seamless loop
Uplifting orchestral resolution, brass and strings, sense of rescue and fresh air
Slow descending dark orchestral swell fading into deep underwater silence
Rescue submarine docking on a hatch underwater, heavy metallic clunk, scraping, magnetic latches engaging, water rushing
Old ship intercom buzz and click, short static
Chemical oxygen candle ignition, sharp hiss of gas release, steady fizzing
Single deep sonar ping with long underwater echo
One slow calm deep human breath in and out, close microphone
Short military console confirmation beep
Heavy hatch wheel spinning free and a submarine escape hatch swinging open with a hiss of equalized pressure
